name: Sit-to-stand (draft)
targetPopulation: Adult rehabilitation patients with low fall risk, able to sit and stand with at most contact-guard supervision. PLACEHOLDER - not a clinical inclusion/exclusion criterion; see docs/study-charter-skeleton.md.
contraindications: Unable to sit/stand independently or with at most contact-guard assistance
symptomStopRules: Stop immediately on new or worsening dizziness
Stop immediately on chest pain or breathlessness disproportionate to exertion
Stop on sharp or new joint pain and report to clinician before resuming
